set.body: Found by S11 (ticket 17b): the missing-cell hatch over uncovered map cells (S2, ticket 8; TrialScene uncovered group, Builder.hatchPaint) renders at ~75% alpha over the screen at some drawing sizes (e.g. ground (226,219,200) instead of warn-soft (251,241,217)) and opaque at others. The spec intends it opaque (never transparent). S11 changed TrialViewMapFxSuite's hatch test to scan at output scale 2 so it passes; check whether that masks the defect. Reproduce across sizes and output scales 1 and 2; determine whether Intaglio's JavaFX pattern-fill backend or the scene's opacity/blend is responsible; fix or record. Epic bd-01M4R9BYCYAZAPHYSK79MVWHKW.
set.title: Missing-cell map hatch renders partly transparent at some sizes
